axis: +X points southeast from the open rail approaches to the concourse and Praed Street. +Z is the Eastbourne Terrace side.
limitations: The main station footprint and platform edges come from PMTiles. Vault heights, the steelwork pattern and the concourse are scaled exterior reconstructions from photographs.

Track pairs between the mapped platforms are approximate and terminate inside the site model. The separately mapped hotel, streets, Underground and canal remain independent. Interiors beyond the visible platforms and concourse edge are outside the reconstruction.
